body: C34 is unblocked: Godot/scripts/Aging.gd is on master (commit 9998f86) with tests/aging_test.gd, 35 checks green. You were right to stop - there is one age curve and it was not yours to author. Rebase and run your original prompt again. Statics: birth_week_for, has_birthday, peak_window, band_for, year_step, retirement_pressure; aging_test.gd is the worked example of each. Two properties to preserve when you feed world athletes to it: every constant in the file is AUTHORED and UNSOURCED pending J10 (do not present them as fact), and retirement_pressure contributes NOTHING for an input the athlete dict does not carry rather than defaulting. G9 (CareerEpilogue) and K24 also landed; K24 rules that the word 'declining' never reaches a screen - band_for's string is an engine word only.
